texts.fd_add_item: Add an item to the basket first.
texts.fd_ask_manager: A manager or the owner can help.
texts.fd_choose_other: Choose another one from the list.
texts.fd_code_sent: A new code is on its way.
texts.fd_country_none: No country matches. Try its dialling code, like 237.
texts.fd_email_format: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
texts.fd_email_throwaway: This email address only lasts a short time. Use an email address you keep.
texts.fd_enter_cash: Type the full amount the customer gave.
texts.fd_go_online: Connect to the internet, then try again.
texts.fd_long: Numbers in {country} have {n} digits. Extra digits are not added.
texts.fd_match_retry: Ask the other device for a new number, then try again.
texts.fd_our_side: Something went wrong on our side. It is not your fault.
texts.fd_owner_access: The owner can give you access.
texts.fd_owner_plan: The owner can choose a bigger plan in Plans and limits.
texts.fd_ref: Reference {ref}. Quote it if you contact support.
texts.fd_short: This number is too short. Numbers in {country} have {n} digits.
texts.fd_use_code: Open the link or type the code from your invitation.
texts.fd_use_ticket: Use the ticket you already have, or leave that queue first.
texts.fd_wait_retry: Wait a moment, then try again.
